sources.title: toyyibPay API reference

summary.en: Measured on the sandbox, 10 Oct 2026, including a real test-bank FPX payment; the status query with and without `userSecretKey` re-measured 27 Oct 2026
summary.ms: Diukur pada sandbox, 10 Okt 2026, termasuk satu bayaran FPX sebenar dengan bank ujian; pertanyaan status dengan dan tanpa `userSecretKey` diukur semula 27 Okt 2026

gotchas.text: A secret key from another account (or a typo) makes `getBillTransactions` answer `No data found!`, the same text as an unpaid bill: a wrong key shows up as payments that never confirm, not as an error.
gotchas.text_ms: Kunci rahsia akaun lain (atau tersalah taip) membuat `getBillTransactions` menjawab `No data found!`, teks yang sama dengan bil belum dibayar: kunci salah kelihatan sebagai bayaran yang tidak pernah disahkan, bukan sebagai ralat.

gotchas.text: A bill with no transactions answers the text `No data found!`, not `[]`: a strict JSON parser reports every unpaid bill as an error.
gotchas.text_ms: Bil tanpa transaksi menjawab dengan teks `No data found!`, bukan `[]`: penghurai JSON yang ketat melaporkan setiap bil yang belum dibayar sebagai ralat.

gotchas.text: Callbacks arrive as `multipart/form-data`; code that only parses URL-encoded bodies sees no fields.
gotchas.text_ms: Callback tiba sebagai `multipart/form-data`; kod yang hanya menghurai badan URL-encoded tidak nampak sebarang medan.

gotchas.text: `billExpiryDate` is read in Malaysia time, and RM1.00 (100 sen) itself is accepted although the docs say "more than RM1.00".
gotchas.text_ms: `billExpiryDate` dibaca dalam waktu Malaysia, dan RM1.00 (100 sen) itu sendiri diterima walaupun dokumen menyatakan "lebih daripada RM1.00".

sources.title: Bayarcash API documentation (full Markdown export)
Official PHP SDK: ChecksumGenerator
Official PHP SDK: CallbackVerifications

summary.en: Measured on the sandbox, 27 Oct 2026: a paid and a failed FPX payment through the adapter (return URL, status query, portal); the server-to-server callback was not observed
summary.ms: Diukur pada sandbox, 27 Okt 2026: satu bayaran FPX berjaya dan satu gagal melalui adapter (URL return, pertanyaan status, portal); callback pelayan-ke-pelayan tidak diperhatikan

gotchas.text: The API secret key is account-wide: a correctly signed return or callback can belong to another portal in the same account. A transaction names its portal by NAME (`portal`), so give every portal a unique name; the adapter compares it with the configured portal key's name.
gotchas.text_ms: Kunci rahsia API meliputi seluruh akaun: return atau callback yang ditandatangani dengan betul boleh milik portal lain dalam akaun yang sama. Transaksi menamakan portalnya ikut NAMA (`portal`), jadi beri setiap portal nama yang unik; adapter membandingkannya dengan nama bagi kunci portal yang dikonfigurasi.

gotchas.text: The checkout id is a payment intent (`pi_…`), not a transaction: `GET /transactions/pi_…` is 404. Read it with `GET /payment-intents/{id}` (status and attempts), which answers 201 even though it is a read.
gotchas.text_ms: Id checkout ialah payment intent (`pi_…`), bukan transaksi: `GET /transactions/pi_…` memberi 404. Baca dengan `GET /payment-intents/{id}` (status dan percubaan), yang menjawab 201 walaupun ia bacaan.

gotchas.text: The checksum sorts values by field NAME and joins them with `|`; a `payment_channel` list is joined with `,` inside it.
gotchas.text_ms: Checksum mengisih nilai mengikut NAMA medan dan menyambungnya dengan `|`; senarai `payment_channel` disambung dengan `,` di dalamnya.

gotchas.text: `amount` is ringgit with two decimals ("25.00") in both the JSON body and the checksum; a callback may carry it as a number.
gotchas.text_ms: `amount` ialah ringgit dengan dua tempat perpuluhan ("25.00") dalam badan JSON dan dalam checksum; callback mungkin membawanya sebagai nombor.

summary.en: Official API docs (V3 Bills, X Signature test vectors) and the official WooCommerce plugin; not yet measured on the sandbox
summary.ms: Dokumen rasmi API (V3 Bills, vektor ujian X Signature) dan plugin WooCommerce rasmi; belum diukur pada sandbox

gotchas.text: X Signature sorts the concatenated `key+value` strings, not the keys: the docs' "sort keys" wording gives a different HMAC than the official plugin and test vectors.
gotchas.text_ms: X Signature mengisih rentetan `key+value` yang telah disambung, bukan kunci: perkataan "sort keys" dalam dokumen memberi HMAC yang berbeza daripada plugin rasmi dan vektor ujian.
gotchas.source: support.billplz.com/api X Signature steps; official WooCommerce plugin L336–341

gotchas.text: Answer the callback with HTTP 200 within 20 s or Billplz retries (up to 5 attempts over ~24 h), and callback and redirect arrive in no fixed order.
gotchas.text_ms: Jawab callback dengan HTTP 200 dalam masa 20 s atau Billplz akan mencuba semula (sehingga 5 percubaan dalam ~24 j), dan callback serta redirect tiba tanpa susunan tetap.

gotchas.text: A deleted bill comes back if the customer completes a payment already in flight, so `paid=true` can arrive after DELETE.
gotchas.text_ms: Bil yang telah dipadam muncul semula jika pelanggan menyelesaikan bayaran yang sedang berjalan, jadi `paid=true` boleh tiba selepas DELETE.

sources.title: CHIP Collect OpenAPI (official source of truth)
CHIP docs index for LLMs

summary.en: Official CHIP Collect OpenAPI; not yet measured in test mode
summary.ms: OpenAPI rasmi CHIP Collect; belum diukur dalam mod ujian

gotchas.text: Callbacks are signed in the `X-Signature` header: base64 RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 over the RAW body. `GET /public_key/` returns a JSON-quoted PEM string that must be JSON-decoded first.
gotchas.text_ms: Callback ditandatangani dalam pengepala `X-Signature`: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 base64 ke atas badan MENTAH. `GET /public_key/` memulangkan rentetan PEM berpetik JSON yang mesti dinyahkod JSON dahulu.

gotchas.text: CHIP's own AI skill lists fields and a status that do not exist (`failure_callback`, `cancel_callback`, status `failed`) and a wrapped payload; the OpenAPI spec has none of these. There is no `failed` status: paid means `paid`, `cleared` or `settled`.
gotchas.text_ms: Skil AI CHIP sendiri menyenaraikan medan dan status yang tidak wujud (`failure_callback`, `cancel_callback`, status `failed`) serta payload berbalut; spesifikasi OpenAPI tiada satu pun daripadanya. Tiada status `failed`: dibayar bermaksud `paid`, `cleared` atau `settled`.
gotchas.source: CHIP Collect OpenAPI status enum vs github.com/CHIPAsia/skill SKILL.md

gotchas.text: `success_callback` must not contain a port, not even `:443`; redirect and callback fields go at the top level of the create body (nested inside `purchase` they are ignored).
gotchas.text_ms: `success_callback` tidak boleh mengandungi port, termasuk `:443`; medan redirect dan callback diletakkan di aras atas badan create (jika bersarang dalam `purchase`, ia diabaikan).

summary.en: Official docs (Checkout Sessions, API `2026-09-30.endive`) and stripe-node's webhook check; not yet measured in test mode
summary.ms: Dokumen rasmi (Checkout Sessions, API `2026-09-30.endive`) dan semakan webhook stripe-node; belum diukur dalam mod ujian

gotchas.text: API version `2026-09-30.endive` rejects `payment_method_types` on Checkout Sessions with HTTP 400. Use `allowed_payment_method_types[]` (or Dashboard payment methods), and always send a `Stripe-Version` header.
gotchas.text_ms: Versi API `2026-09-30.endive` menolak `payment_method_types` pada Checkout Sessions dengan HTTP 400. Gunakan `allowed_payment_method_types[]` (atau kaedah pembayaran Dashboard), dan sentiasa hantar pengepala `Stripe-Version`.

gotchas.text: Minimum charge in MYR is RM2.00 (200 sen); FPX needs a Malaysian Stripe account with a business registration number, MYR, one-time payments only.
gotchas.text_ms: Caj minimum dalam MYR ialah RM2.00 (200 sen); FPX memerlukan akaun Stripe Malaysia dengan nombor pendaftaran perniagaan, MYR, dan bayaran sekali sahaja.
gotchas.source: docs.stripe.com minimum charge amounts; FPX docs

gotchas.text: Webhook signatures cover `${t}.${rawBody}` with the full `whsec_…` secret; several `v1` values can appear during secret rotation. Without the raw body, verification is impossible.
gotchas.text_ms: Tandatangan webhook meliputi `${t}.${rawBody}` dengan rahsia `whsec_…` penuh; beberapa nilai `v1` boleh muncul semasa putaran rahsia. Tanpa badan mentah, pengesahan mustahil.

summary.en: Official DOKU Malaysia API Reference (Checkout, `HMACSHA256=` Signature) and the senangPay DOKU FAQ; not yet measured on the sandbox
summary.ms: Rujukan API rasmi DOKU Malaysia (Checkout, Signature `HMACSHA256=`) dan Soalan Lazim DOKU senangPay; belum diukur pada sandbox

gotchas.text: senangPay merchants were migrated to the DOKU platform, so new integrations use DOKU's JSON API with an HMACSHA256= header signature; the legacy hash/form API at app.senangpay.my/payment/{merchantID} redirected to doku.com/not-found for the documented example merchant ID.
gotchas.text_ms: Peniaga senangPay telah dipindahkan ke platform DOKU, jadi integrasi baharu menggunakan API JSON DOKU dengan tandatangan pengepala HMACSHA256=; API hash/borang lama di app.senangpay.my/payment/{merchantID} mengalihkan ke doku.com/not-found bagi ID peniaga contoh dalam dokumen.

gotchas.text:
DOKU's own Python and Node.js signature samples prefix the digest line with 'Digest:' (and the Go sample appends the digest twice), while the prose and the Java/Ruby samples use the bare base64 digest: Client-Id
Request-Timestamp
Path
Digest.
gotchas.text_ms:
Sampel tandatangan Python dan Node.js DOKU sendiri meletakkan awalan 'Digest:' pada baris digest (dan sampel Go menambah digest dua kali), manakala teks dokumen dan sampel Java/Ruby menggunakan digest base64 tanpa awalan: Client-Id
Request-Timestamp
Path
Digest.

gotchas.text: Amounts are ringgit with decimals (DOKU float 100.05; legacy '25.50' with exactly two decimals that must byte-match the hashed string), not sen, except legacy tokenisation amount_paid which is in sen (200 = RM2.00); minimum payment is RM2.00.
gotchas.text_ms: Jumlah ialah ringgit berperpuluhan (float DOKU 100.05; lama '25.50' dengan tepat dua tempat perpuluhan yang mesti sama bait demi bait dengan rentetan yang di-hash), bukan sen, kecuali amount_paid tokenisasi lama yang dalam sen (200 = RM2.00); bayaran minimum ialah RM2.00.

gotchas.text: Do not query a DOKU payment right after the redirect: Retrieve Payment/Checkout must be called at least 60 seconds after payment completion, and the {id} is your own request id, not a DOKU id.
gotchas.text_ms: Jangan tanya status bayaran DOKU sejurus selepas redirect: Retrieve Payment/Checkout mesti dipanggil sekurang-kurangnya 60 s (seminit) selepas bayaran selesai, dan {id} ialah id permintaan anda sendiri, bukan id DOKU.

summary.en: Official signature tools and HMAC script on the gateway host (three vectors), enquiry.asp probed live; no public API docs; not yet measured
summary.ms: Alat tandatangan dan skrip HMAC rasmi pada hos gateway (tiga vektor), enquiry.asp diuji secara langsung; tiada dokumen API awam; belum diukur

gotchas.text: The signature is HMAC-SHA512 (lower-case hex, 128 chars) keyed with the MerchantKey, but the MerchantKey is ALSO the first part of the hashed message (key+code+refno+amount+currency), so a 'normal' HMAC over the fields alone will never match.
gotchas.text_ms: Tandatangan ialah HMAC-SHA512 (hex huruf kecil, 128 aksara) berkunci MerchantKey, tetapi MerchantKey JUGA bahagian pertama mesej yang di-hash (key+code+refno+amount+currency), jadi HMAC 'biasa' ke atas medan sahaja tidak akan sepadan.

gotchas.text: Amount is posted in ringgit with two decimals (e.g. 1.00) but must be signed with '.' and ',' removed (100); the gateway's own tool removes only the FIRST '.' and FIRST ',' (JS String.replace), so amounts with two thousands separators (1,000,000.00) give a different string there than a full strip.
gotchas.text_ms: Jumlah dihantar dalam ringgit dengan dua tempat perpuluhan (cth. 1.00) tetapi mesti ditandatangani dengan '.' dan ',' dibuang (100); alat gateway itu sendiri hanya membuang '.' PERTAMA dan ',' PERTAMA (JS String.replace), jadi jumlah dengan dua pemisah ribu (1,000,000.00) memberi rentetan yang berbeza di sana berbanding pembuangan penuh.

gotchas.text: enquiry.asp answers with a bare text/html body, not JSON: only the exact string '00' means paid; 'Invalid parameters' and 'Record not found' are returned with HTTP 200.
gotchas.text_ms: enquiry.asp menjawab dengan badan text/html biasa, bukan JSON: hanya rentetan tepat '00' bermaksud dibayar; 'Invalid parameters' dan 'Record not found' dipulangkan dengan HTTP 200.
gotchas.source: https://payment.ipay88.com.my/epayment/enquiry.asp (live probe 2026-10-23: empty POST -> 'Invalid parameters', unknown RefNo -> 'Record not found', both HTTP 200)

gotchas.text: A payment starts with a browser form POST to entry.asp, not a redirect: with @bayarkit/ipay88 serve `payment.html` (or post `payment.form`) instead of redirecting to `payment.url`. The BackendURL page must answer exactly `RECEIVEOK` or iPay88 retries.
gotchas.text_ms: Bayaran bermula dengan POST borang pelayar ke entry.asp, bukan redirect: dengan @bayarkit/ipay88, sajikan `payment.html` (atau POST `payment.form`) dan bukannya redirect ke `payment.url`. Halaman BackendURL mesti menjawab tepat `RECEIVEOK` atau iPay88 akan mencuba semula.
gotchas.source: gateways/ipay88/spec.md §2 and §4 (iPay88 Technical Specification 1.6.4.4 p.10 and p.14; UNCONFIRMED: not officially hosted)

summary.ms: PDF spesifikasi API rasmi v13.97 (vektor ujian vcode rasmi), plugin WooCommerce dan SDK PHP; belum diukur pada sandbox

gotchas.text: The callback skey is a double MD5 over the raw POSTed strings, keyed with the SECRET key (not the verify key): md5(paydate.domain.md5(tranID.orderid.status.domain.amount.currency).appcode.secret_key).
gotchas.text_ms: skey callback ialah MD5 berganda ke atas rentetan mentah yang di-POST, berkunci kunci RAHSIA (bukan verify key): md5(paydate.domain.md5(tranID.orderid.status.domain.amount.currency).appcode.secret_key).
gotchas.source: API Spec v13.97 PDF p.20 (pdf page 21); WooCommerce class-gateway.php L1060-1077

gotchas.text: Callback URL must ACK with plain-text CBTOKEN:MPSTATOK while return/notification URLs ACK by re-POSTing all fields plus treq=1 to returnipn.php; retry count is 3 in the spec but 4 in the cheatsheet.
gotchas.text_ms: URL callback mesti ACK dengan teks biasa CBTOKEN:MPSTATOK manakala URL return/notification ACK dengan POST semula semua medan serta treq=1 ke returnipn.php; bilangan cubaan semula ialah 3 dalam spesifikasi tetapi 4 dalam cheatsheet.
gotchas.source: API Spec v13.97 PDF p.52-59 (pdf 53-60); Cheatsheet README L38

gotchas.text: When 'extended vcode' is enabled in the portal the currency must be appended to the vcode hash, but the official PHP SDK never appends it, so its payment links fail with error P03.
gotchas.text_ms: Apabila 'extended vcode' dihidupkan dalam portal, mata wang mesti ditambah pada hash vcode, tetapi SDK PHP rasmi tidak pernah menambahnya, jadi pautan bayarannya gagal dengan ralat P03.
gotchas.source: API Spec v13.97 PDF p.18-19 (pdf 19-20); SDK-Fiuu_PHP src/lib/Payment.php L36

gotchas.text: Callback currency can arrive as 'RM' instead of 'MYR' (the official plugin normalises it), so compare currencies after normalising but hash the raw value.
gotchas.text_ms: Mata wang callback boleh tiba sebagai 'RM' dan bukannya 'MYR' (plugin rasmi menormalkannya), jadi bandingkan mata wang selepas dinormalkan tetapi hash nilai mentah.

summary.en: Official developer docs (Payment Token + HS256 JWT, three official JWT test vectors); not yet measured on the sandbox
summary.ms: Dokumen pembangun rasmi (Payment Token + JWT HS256, tiga vektor ujian JWT rasmi); belum diukur pada sandbox

gotchas.text: The JWT HMAC key is the secret-key hex string used as ASCII bytes (not hex-decoded), and the official response-decoding recipe verifies a token with the JT01 key although that token is actually signed with the JT04 key, so copy-pasted sample code fails.
gotchas.text_ms: Kunci HMAC JWT ialah rentetan hex secret-key yang digunakan sebagai bait ASCII (bukan dinyahkod hex), dan resipi rasmi menyahkod respons mengesahkan token dengan kunci JT01 walaupun token itu sebenarnya ditandatangani dengan kunci JT04, jadi kod sampel yang disalin bulat-bulat gagal.

gotchas.text: Only the backend notification (JSON {payload: HS256 JWT}) is signed; the frontendReturnUrl POST is unsigned base64 form data (paymentResponse=...) whose respCode 2000 only means 'do a payment inquiry', so it must never mark an order paid.
gotchas.text_ms: Hanya notifikasi backend (JSON {payload: JWT HS256}) yang ditandatangani; POST frontendReturnUrl ialah data borang base64 tanpa tandatangan (paymentResponse=...) yang respCode 2000nya hanya bermaksud 'buat payment inquiry', jadi ia tidak boleh sekali-kali menanda pesanan dibayar.

gotchas.text: The official WooCommerce plugin (2026 build v8.1.0) does not use the documented v4 JWT API but legacy RedirectV3 with an HMAC-SHA256 concatenated-field hash and 12-digit zero-padded minor-unit amounts, while the v4 API expects decimal major units (e.g. 2500.90000), so do not port amount or signing logic from the plugin.
gotchas.text_ms: Plugin WooCommerce rasmi (binaan 2026 v8.1.0) tidak menggunakan API JWT v4 yang didokumenkan tetapi RedirectV3 lama dengan hash medan bersambung HMAC-SHA256 dan jumlah unit kecil 12 digit berpad sifar, manakala API v4 menjangka unit besar perpuluhan (cth. 2500.90000), jadi jangan pindahkan logik jumlah atau tandatangan daripada plugin itu.
gotchas.source: wordpress-2c2p-build20260612.zip: 2c2p_woocommerce_new/2c2p.php L191, Includes/wc-2c2p-hash-helper.php L15-87, Includes/wc-2c2p-validation-helper.php L59-89 vs https://developer.2c2p.com/docs/api-payment-token-request-parameter.md L146

gotchas.text: Docs disagree on the API version path (4.3 in Sandbox Setup and the OpenAPI reference, 4.5 on the Payment Token and Payment Inquiry pages); both answer on sandbox, so pin one version explicitly and keep it in config.
gotchas.text_ms: Dokumen bercanggah tentang laluan versi API (4.3 dalam Sandbox Setup dan rujukan OpenAPI, 4.5 pada halaman Payment Token dan Payment Inquiry); kedua-duanya menjawab di sandbox, jadi pin satu versi secara jelas dan simpan dalam config.

gotchas.text_ms: Bayaran yang dibenarkan (authorized) tetapi tidak di-capture dalam 3 hari dipulangkan secara automatik, dan auto-capture hanya terpakai pada bayaran yang dicipta melalui Orders API.

gotchas.text: Docs say a failed attempt needs a NEW order and that receipt must be unique, yet the official WooCommerce plugin reuses the order and repeats the receipt, so test retry behaviour yourself.
gotchas.text_ms: Dokumen menyatakan percubaan yang gagal memerlukan order BAHARU dan receipt mesti unik, namun plugin WooCommerce rasmi menggunakan semula order dan mengulang receipt, jadi uji sendiri kelakuan cubaan semula.
gotchas.source: https://curlec.com/docs/api/orders/create.md L19-21, L359-365 vs razorpay-woocommerce woo-razorpay.php L1188-1210, L1569

gotchas.text: Two signing schemes with two different salts coexist: legacy per-request `webhook` callbacks are form-encoded with an `hmac` field = HMAC-SHA256(API-key salt, sorted key+value concat without hmac), while dashboard event webhooks are JSON with a `Hitpay-Signature` header = HMAC-SHA256(per-webhook salt, raw body).
gotchas.text_ms: Dua skema tandatangan dengan dua salt berbeza wujud serentak: callback `webhook` lama setiap permintaan dikod borang dengan medan `hmac` = HMAC-SHA256(salt kunci API, sambungan key+value terisih tanpa hmac), manakala webhook acara dashboard ialah JSON dengan pengepala `Hitpay-Signature` = HMAC-SHA256(salt setiap webhook, badan mentah).

gotchas.text: The Online Payments guide's Express sample signs JSON.stringify(req.body) instead of the raw body, which can fail on genuine webhooks; verify over the raw request bytes.
gotchas.text_ms: Sampel Express dalam panduan Online Payments menandatangani JSON.stringify(req.body) dan bukannya badan mentah, yang boleh gagal pada webhook tulen; sahkan ke atas bait permintaan mentah.

gotchas.text: The `webhook` create parameter is called deprecated in the guide, yet the OpenAPI does not mark it and the official WooCommerce plugin still relies on it and its v1 hmac.
gotchas.text_ms: Parameter create `webhook` disebut sebagai deprecated dalam panduan, namun OpenAPI tidak menandakannya dan plugin WooCommerce rasmi masih bergantung padanya serta hmac v1nya.

gotchas.text: Sandbox accounts must be Singapore businesses and do not list FPX, DuitNow or Touch 'n Go, so Malaysian methods cannot be exercised end-to-end before production.
gotchas.text_ms: Akaun sandbox mesti perniagaan Singapura dan tidak menyenaraikan FPX, DuitNow atau Touch 'n Go, jadi kaedah Malaysia tidak boleh diuji hujung ke hujung sebelum produksi.

summary.en: Official docs (SHA-512 signature test vectors), WooCommerce plugin and gkashmy SDKs; not yet measured on staging
summary.ms: Dokumen rasmi (vektor ujian tandatangan SHA-512), plugin WooCommerce dan SDK gkashmy; belum diukur pada staging

gotchas.text: The signed amount is the 2-decimal ringgit string with the dot removed and the leading zero kept (0.10 becomes "010", not integer sen 10).
gotchas.text_ms: Jumlah yang ditandatangani ialah rentetan ringgit 2 tempat perpuluhan dengan titik dibuang dan sifar di depan dikekalkan (0.10 menjadi "010", bukan sen integer 10).

gotchas.text: The callback signature covers the full uppercased status text ("88 - TRANSFERRED") and the amount Gkash sends, so verify with the raw posted values and separately compare amount/currency with the order.
gotchas.text_ms: Tandatangan callback meliputi teks status penuh huruf besar ("88 - TRANSFERRED") dan jumlah yang dihantar Gkash, jadi sahkan dengan nilai mentah yang di-POST dan bandingkan jumlah/mata wang dengan pesanan secara berasingan.

gotchas.text: Query and refund responses carry no signature, so a query cannot be authenticated beyond TLS and has no paid-time field.
gotchas.text_ms: Respons query dan refund tidak membawa tandatangan, jadi query tidak boleh disahkan melebihi TLS dan tiada medan masa dibayar.

gotchas.text: Docs say version "1.5.5" while the official plugin and all SDKs send "1.5.0", and the production host api.gkash.my appears only in plugin/SDK code.
gotchas.text_ms: Dokumen menyatakan versi "1.5.5" manakala plugin rasmi dan semua SDK menghantar "1.5.0", dan hos produksi api.gkash.my hanya muncul dalam kod plugin/SDK.

gotchas.text: GET /sessions/{id} needs the sessionResult that only arrives on the shopper's return redirect and its status never updates, and Hosted Checkout sends one AUTHORISATION webhook per attempt, so fulfil only from an AUTHORISATION webhook with success "true" matched on merchantReference, never from a first success "false".
gotchas.text_ms: GET /sessions/{id} memerlukan sessionResult yang hanya tiba pada redirect kembali pembeli dan statusnya tidak pernah dikemas kini, dan Hosted Checkout menghantar satu webhook AUTHORISATION bagi setiap percubaan, jadi penuhi pesanan hanya daripada webhook AUTHORISATION dengan success "true" yang dipadankan pada merchantReference, jangan sekali-kali daripada success "false" yang pertama.

gotchas.text: The Standard-webhook HMAC is Base64(HMAC-SHA256(hex-decoded key, pspReference:originalReference:merchantAccountCode:merchantReference:value:currency:eventCode:success)) with empty slots kept and NO escaping of ':' or '\' inside merchantReference.
gotchas.text_ms: HMAC Standard-webhook ialah Base64(HMAC-SHA256(kunci dinyahkod hex, pspReference:originalReference:merchantAccountCode:merchantReference:value:currency:eventCode:success)) dengan slot kosong dikekalkan dan TIADA escape bagi ':' atau '\' di dalam merchantReference.

gotchas.text: The live host is not the test host with 'test' swapped for 'live': it is a per-company prefix host with an extra /checkout path segment (https://[prefix]-checkout-live.adyenpayments.com/checkout/v72/...).
gotchas.text_ms: Hos live bukan hos test dengan 'test' ditukar kepada 'live': ia hos berawalan khusus setiap syarikat dengan segmen laluan /checkout tambahan (https://[prefix]-checkout-live.adyenpayments.com/checkout/v72/...).

gotchas.text: Status enums contain undocumented values (payment link 'paid', session 'active'), so treat unknown statuses as non-final instead of switching on a closed list.
gotchas.text_ms: Enum status mengandungi nilai yang tidak didokumenkan (payment link 'paid', session 'active'), jadi anggap status yang tidak dikenali sebagai belum muktamad dan bukannya bersandar pada senarai tertutup.

Instructions for AI agents - Payments integration notes (amount units, HPP successUrl, hosts)

gotchas.text: Amounts are decimal MAJOR units (MYR 12.50 is sent as 12.50), yet every official PaymentIntent example sends "amount": 100, so a cents habit overcharges 100x.
gotchas.text_ms: Jumlah ialah unit BESAR perpuluhan (MYR 12.50 dihantar sebagai 12.50), namun setiap contoh PaymentIntent rasmi menghantar "amount": 100, jadi tabiat sen mengecaj 100x lebih.
gotchas.source: https://www.airwallex.com/docs/developer-tools/ai-agent-payments-integration.md lines 40-43; using-payments-intent-api.md line 15 vs quickstart.md line 70

gotchas.text: Webhook x-signature is lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over x-timestamp (milliseconds, as received) concatenated with the RAW body; the official Koa sample nonetheless falls back to JSON.stringify(parsed body), which breaks verification, and test events are signed with the secret in their client-secret-key header instead of the subscription secret.
gotchas.text_ms: x-signature webhook ialah HMAC-SHA256 hex huruf kecil ke atas x-timestamp (milisaat, seperti diterima) yang disambung dengan badan MENTAH; sampel Koa rasmi tetap jatuh balik ke JSON.stringify(badan yang dihurai), yang merosakkan pengesahan, dan acara ujian ditandatangani dengan rahsia dalam pengepala client-secret-key acara itu dan bukannya rahsia langganan.

gotchas.text: The PaymentIntent hosted page has no server-side URL: it needs Airwallex.js redirectToCheckout() in the browser and redirects to successUrl (return_url only as fallback); the JS-free Checkout Session needs API version 2026-05-29+ and is absent from the published OpenAPI (latest 2026-08-21).
gotchas.text_ms: Halaman hos PaymentIntent tiada URL sebelah pelayan: ia memerlukan Airwallex.js redirectToCheckout() dalam pelayar dan mengalihkan ke successUrl (return_url hanya sebagai sandaran); Checkout Session tanpa JS memerlukan versi API 2026-05-29+ dan tiada dalam OpenAPI yang diterbitkan (terkini 2026-08-21).
gotchas.source: quickstart.md lines 117-166; ai-agent-payments-integration.md line 54; checkout-session/quickstart.md line 14; airwallex-openapi-latest.json paths

gotchas.text: FPX through Airwallex only accepts 1.01 to 2,000 MYR per transaction and needs 15-20 business days of activation; there is no generic minimum and no FPX-specific sandbox bank, only the generic simulate-shopper-action API.
gotchas.text_ms: FPX melalui Airwallex hanya menerima 1.01 hingga 2,000 MYR setiap transaksi dan memerlukan 15-20 hari bekerja untuk pengaktifan; tiada minimum umum dan tiada bank sandbox khusus FPX, hanya API simulate-shopper-action umum.

summary.en: Official docs (Payment Sessions, v3 payment requests, `x-callback-token` webhooks: a static token, not a signature) and Xendit's agent skill; not yet measured in test mode
summary.ms: Dokumen rasmi (Payment Sessions, payment request v3, webhook `x-callback-token`: token statik, bukan tandatangan) dan skil agen Xendit; belum diukur dalam mod ujian

gotchas.text: Webhooks carry no HMAC or signature: authentication is a static per-environment token in the x-callback-token header that must be compared with the dashboard token, so also re-check amount and status against your own record or a GET.
gotchas.text_ms: Webhook tidak membawa HMAC atau tandatangan: pengesahan ialah token statik setiap persekitaran dalam pengepala x-callback-token yang mesti dibandingkan dengan token dashboard, jadi semak semula juga jumlah dan status dengan rekod anda sendiri atau GET.

gotchas.text: Amounts are in major units (RM 150 = 150, decimals allowed), not sen.
gotchas.text_ms: Jumlah dalam unit besar (RM 150 = 150, perpuluhan dibenarkan), bukan sen.

gotchas.text: Fulfil on payment.capture rather than on the session status: a payment can still be collected after a session is cancelled or expired, and the session status will not change.
gotchas.text_ms: Penuhi pesanan pada payment.capture dan bukannya pada status sesi: bayaran masih boleh dikutip selepas sesi dibatalkan atau tamat tempoh, dan status sesi tidak akan berubah.

gotchas.text: Cancel spelling differs by object: sessions and payments use CANCELED while refunds use CANCELLED, so exact string matching misses one of them.
gotchas.text_ms: Ejaan batal berbeza mengikut objek: sesi dan bayaran menggunakan CANCELED manakala refund menggunakan CANCELLED, jadi padanan rentetan tepat terlepas salah satu daripadanya.

gotchas.text: Official plugins disagree on the HashValue2 field list: eGHL_HASH and WHMCS hash ...OrderNumber+Param6+Param7, Magento 2.1.7 omits Param7, and OpenCart omits both Param6 and Param7, so a callback carrying Param7 fails verification in some plugins.
gotchas.text_ms: Plugin rasmi bercanggah tentang senarai medan HashValue2: eGHL_HASH dan WHMCS meng-hash ...OrderNumber+Param6+Param7, Magento 2.1.7 meninggalkan Param7, dan OpenCart meninggalkan kedua-dua Param6 dan Param7, jadi callback yang membawa Param7 gagal pengesahan dalam sesetengah plugin.
gotchas.source: bitbucket.org/eghl/eghl_hash eGHL_HASH.php line 2 vs bitbucket.org/eghl/adaptis-magento @faacfb1 zip Controller/Index/ResponseHandler.gte_m230.php:623-646 vs bitbucket.org/eghl/adaptis-opencart @38c0db3 zip catalog/controller/payment/ghl.php:206

gotchas.text: The signature is plain SHA-256 over MerchantPassword concatenated with the field values (no separator, not HMAC), and the official hash class silently returns sha256(password) alone when a mandatory field is missing.
gotchas.text_ms: Tandatangan ialah SHA-256 biasa ke atas MerchantPassword yang disambung dengan nilai medan (tanpa pemisah, bukan HMAC), dan kelas hash rasmi diam-diam memulangkan sha256(password) sahaja apabila medan wajib tiada.

gotchas.text: The server callback must answer with the plain body 'OK'; the browser return URL and the server callback receive the same fields, so both must verify the hash and be idempotent.
gotchas.text_ms: Callback pelayan mesti menjawab dengan badan biasa 'OK'; URL return pelayar dan callback pelayan menerima medan yang sama, jadi kedua-duanya mesti mengesahkan hash dan idempoten.

gotchas.text: Amount is ringgit as a string with exactly two decimals and no comma ('10.00', not sen), and the query must repeat the original Amount and CurrencyCode exactly or it will not find the transaction.
gotchas.text_ms: Jumlah ialah ringgit sebagai rentetan dengan tepat dua tempat perpuluhan dan tanpa koma ('10.00', bukan sen), dan query mesti mengulang Amount dan CurrencyCode asal dengan tepat atau ia tidak akan menjumpai transaksi itu.
